caption:
"Something might happen" is impossible to plan for. "Arriving after dark in a city I don't know" is a problem with solutions.

This 10-minute exercise turns a vague fear into three moments you can actually plan for.

Save it and try it this weekend. 🧭

#solotravel #solofemaletravel #travelalone #womenwhotravel #anxietytips #confidence #personalgrowth #booksforwomen

slides.title: The fear list.
slides.subtitle: Turn "something might happen" into a plan.

slides.heading: Write every reason
slides.body: Every reason you haven't travelled alone yet. Don't filter. Include the ones that sound silly.

slides.heading: Practical or feeling?
slides.body: Mark each one: a practical reason (money, time, care) or a feeling (fear, embarrassment, uncertainty).

slides.heading: Name the moment
slides.body:
Not "being unsafe" but "walking from the station to the hotel at night".
Not "being lonely" but "dinner alone on the first evening".

slides.heading: Circle three
slides.body: Circle the three moments that worry you most. Each one has a plan. Find it, then cross it off.

slides.title: Save this for later.
slides.body:
Fear shrinks when you look
at it closely.
